items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: And Ms. Josie's, I used to shine Ms. Josie's boots.

ctx.x: We'll say this is real number three on Tommy Ridgely.

Oh, yeah, real number three on Tommy Ridgely, and we were right at Ms. Josie. Well, when I was a kid, she had a shoe. I used to go around and shine her boots at Carrier's Riding Academy, whatever it was. It was Carrier's. I know Mr. Carrier, yeah. And Ms. Josie's, I used to shine Ms. Josie's boots.
Now this is our role number.
